Specification: This module specifies and proves a simple arithmetic fact over natural numbers: for every natural number x, the sum x+x is even. It defines predicates Even and Odd in terms of the remainder modulo 2, then states the target theorem both directly and as a named theorem T1. The file contains TLAPS proofs, including a one-step proof using Z3 and a more explicit stepwise proof by case distinction on whether x is even or odd.
